 Before
 Hon'Ble The Chief Justice (Acting) Mr. N. Kotiswar Singh
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manish Choudhury
 :: O R D E R :
[N. Kotiswar Singh, CJ(Acting)] Heard Mr. S.S. Dey, learned senior counsel for the Appellants.

Also heard Mr. P. N. Goswami, learned Standing Counsel,
Excise Department; Mr. N.N.B. Choudhury, learned Government Advocate,
Arunachal Pradesh; Ms. M. Keichi, learned Government Advocate, Nagaland and Mr.
P.K. Sharma, learned counsel for respondent No. 7 in WA No. 81/2020.

Pending any further consideration by this Court, let a sample of the of beverages be sent to SGS India Pvt. Limited, Kolkata, which is an FSSAI notified NABL Accredited Food Testing Laboratory as per the Food Safety and Standards (Alcoholic Beverages) Regulations, 2019 and submit the report about the quality of the beverages.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Alcoholic Beverages) Regulations, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The said samples shall be collected by the Excise Department in presence of the representatives of the writ appellants as well as the respondent No. 7.
Mr. P. K. Sharma, learned counsel for the respondent No. 7 submits that he may be allowed to file an affidavit.
He may do so.
List these matters accordingly on 09.12.2020.

JUDGE CHIEF JUSTICE (ACTING)
